the parameters investigated have an impact on the partition coefficient and yield.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cloud point extraction is suitable for technical scale purification of proteins from whole broths.
for the investigated protein, the best conditions for a technical scale application are: 1% (w/w) detergent in 1 M KCl at 50°C.

cloud point extraction is a promising method for the purification of proteins and that it is possible to optimize it for technical scale.
